bio: Spoil yourself to a delicious afternoon tea at St. Ermins Hotel, where you can enjoy a selection of mouth-watering treats including sandwiches, scones and decadent sweets.  Nestled down a tree-lined courtyard, this independent hotel's unique blend of historically significant interiors and textural design creates a warm and relaxed atmosphere. Service is attentive and friendly, ensuring everyone feels at home.  St. Ermin's is located in the heart of Westminster, only a minute's walk from St. James's Park tube.
